line.title: Open your line
line.hint: A queue is what guests join. Create one and your join link works.

hours.title: Set your opening hours
hours.hint: Until you do, your line accepts guests at any time of day.

team.title: Invite a teammate
team.hint: Staff call the next guest from their own phone.

screen.title: Pair a screen

poster.title: Print the poster
poster.hint: Put the QR code where guests walk in.
